title: slide.create input
description: Create a deck from a natural-language brief.

workflow.description: html is fast/non-editable; template is slower/editable; auto routes from template presence.

template.description: Optional template path or template name.

max_slides.description: Requested total slide count. Requests above the per-file deck limit are split into multiple PPTX outputs.

source_artifacts.description: Optional artifacts forwarded by the orchestrator, including raw PDF/DOC/DOCX/PPT/PPTX source documents or docs.parse_bundle outputs used as deck source material.

source_documents.description: Optional parsed document summaries from docs.parse_bundle.
